name: BJ's One+ Mastercard
effective_cost: Free card, but requires a BJ's Club+ membership ($120/yr) to hold it
balance_transfer_fee: None for balances transferred at the Balance Transfer APR

verdict.text: Worth it only if you already pay for BJ's Club+ membership

earn_rates.category: In-club at BJ's, BJs.com & the BJ's app
BJ's Gas, discount at the pump, not a rewards rate

earn_note: The 5%/2% rate requires a BJ's Club+ membership ($120/yr, the club's premium tier); with a BJ's Club membership you get the lesser BJ's One card instead (3%/1.5%). Club+ on its own pays 2% back on most BJ's purchases, capped at $500 in rewards a year, but cardholders earn under the card's terms instead, with no cap. Gas at BJ's Gas is a 15¢/gal discount at the pump, not rewards, and BJ's Gas purchases don't earn. Eye exams, tax, bottle deposits, alcohol, tobacco, lottery, gift cards and propane don't earn, and neither do same-day delivery and pickup fees, BJ's Gas, or purchases through PayPal and other third-party wallets.

redemption_options.method: At BJ's checkout in-club, on BJs.com or in the BJ's app, toward purchases or membership fees

points.per_100k: Not applicable: rewards accrue as a dollar balance, not a points currency
points.note: A flat cash-back balance, not points. You can redeem once it reaches $10, but you have to use all the rewards presented to you at once, on a purchase of at least $10. Rewards can also pay your BJ's membership fee. They're yours for the life of the account, with no cash-out to a bank account or statement credit; they're locked to BJ's.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners and no travel redemption: rewards are a closed-loop balance usable only at BJ's.

protection_note: No purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel coverage documented in the cardholder agreement: identical thin protection profile to the base BJ's One. The higher earn rate is the entire pitch; there's no insurance upside to holding the '+' version.
rental_note: No rental car coverage of any kind.

services.name: BJ's Club+ membership required
services.detail: Only available to BJ's Club+ members ($120/yr, the club's premium tier); BJ's Club members get the lower-earning BJ's One card instead. Membership is billed separately and isn't discounted by the card. A downgrade back to BJ's One happens only at membership renewal.

services.name: Card lock & account management
services.detail: Mobile app card lock, autopay, and flexible due-date selection via Capital One's servicing platform.

services.name: World Elite Mastercard benefits
services.detail: Mastercard ID Theft Protection, Travel & Lifestyle Services, 24/7 Concierge and Mastercard Merchant Offers.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns the same rewards rate (into your account)

additional_cards.note: Free to add, but the household still needs its own BJ's membership card at the register; this credit card doesn't grant club access on its own.

timeline.text: Capital One took over as issuer from Comenity, relaunching the BJ's Perks Elite Mastercard as BJ's One+ (and the Perks Plus Mastercard as BJ's One), on the Mastercard network.
